defaultPrompt: Who in my programs shares my personal interests?
Show my Eco commitments and pending tasks.
Help me prepare for my upcoming Unreasonable program.
interface.longDescription: Connect your Eco account to find people, ventures, and funders; review commitments and pending tasks; and explore programs and fundraising support. Staff tools are available according to your Eco account permissions.

name: unreasonable-eco
description: Connect to Unreasonable Eco to search the community, review commitments, explore programs, and manage supported Eco workflows.

positive.description: Directory name lookup. Setup: authorized Eco account with directory access.
positive.prompt: Find Paul Arterburn in the Unreasonable community.
positive.expected_behavior: Search people for Paul Arterburn; show only returned matches and their Eco profile references. If there is no visible match, report that result without inventing a person.

positive.description: Thematic venture discovery. Setup: authorized Eco account with access to venture search.
positive.prompt: Find ventures working on water conservation.
positive.expected_behavior: Use semantic_search with search_type for ventures and a water conservation query. Explain each match using returned profile evidence, and preserve returned profile references.

positive.description: Personal commitments review. Setup: dedicated reviewer account with sample received commitments.
positive.prompt: Show the commitments other people have made to help me.
positive.expected_behavior: Return commitments addressed to the authenticated account. Attribute benefactor, offer, and status to returned data; do not include commitments made by this account to other people, and do not mutate status.

positive.description: Personal pending tasks. Setup: dedicated reviewer account with sample open tasks.
positive.prompt: What pending tasks do I have in Eco?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the authenticated account's returned pending tasks and available action links. Do not claim any task has been completed.

positive.description: Upcoming program preparation. Setup: reviewer account assigned to an upcoming or in-residence sample program.
positive.prompt: Help me prepare for my upcoming Unreasonable program.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the returned program context to identify the program, schedule, and outstanding onboarding steps with their links. If no program is assigned, explain that limitation without inventing one.

positive.description: Shared personal interests. Setup: authorized account whose profile states a personal interest and shares a program with another visible person.
positive.prompt: Who from my Eco programs shares my personal interests? Prefer people who live near me.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the authenticated user and read personal interests from their returned profile. Shortlist people who share one of their programs, cite the profile evidence, and rank closer returned locations higher. Do not substitute professional expertise, invent a shared interest, use a street address, or send a message.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion. Explain that Eco MCP does not support deleting commitments. Do not call update_commitment or any other mutating tool to approximate deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete all of the commitments people have made to me.

negative.description: Unsupported sending. Explain that this plugin cannot send ticket email; drafting is distinct from sending. Do not call draft_ticket_reply as if it sent an email or invoke another mutating tool.
negative.prompt: Send an email to every person in my Eco search results right now.

negative.description: Unsupported CRM writing. Explain that Copper CRM queries are read-only and sync_copper_record updates Eco only. Do not invoke query_copper_crm or sync_copper_record to claim a Copper record was changed.
negative.prompt: Change the company name of my Copper CRM contact to Example Company.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not process payments or support purchases.

publication.release_notes: Add the find-people-who-share-your-interests workflow for shared interests among people from the user's Eco programs, with a proximity boost. Preserve the existing workflows, MCP connection, and logo metadata.
